captions.detailed: This 3D model features a carillon bell tower consisting of a tall, square stone-colored shaft on a wider base, topped by an open belfry stage. Underneath a dark-grey domed roof, five brass-colored bells of varying sizes are suspended from horizontal wooden-colored headstocks. Each bell can swing independently about its own horizontal axis using a revolute joint connected to its headstock.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an articulated carillon bell tower. The tower should feature a tall, square stone shaft with a base, an open belfry stage, and a dark dome roof. Inside the belfry, hang five bronze bells of varying sizes on horizontal headstocks, each configured with a revolute joint to swing independently.
captions.factory: The code constructs a single 'tower' part representing the main shaft, base, belfry columns, and dome roof using a series of box primitives, extruded frames, and a lofted/domed shape. It then creates five distinct 'bell' parts, each modeled using a combination of a cylinder for the headstock and a custom-lofted shell for the bell flare. These bell parts are linked to the 'tower' using five separate revolute articulations with horizontal rotation axes, positioned linearly across the belfry space.
